meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 管理 Git 提交、变基、搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常用 Git 管理代码版本
copy.tagline_en: Manage Git commits, rebase, and search history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently use Git for version control

howto.what: 装上后，涉及 git 操作时，Claude 会分析仓库状态和近期提交风格，把改动拆成多个原子提交；还会用 rebase/squash 整理历史，或用 blame、bisect、log -S 查找某行代码或改动是何时、何地引入的。
howto.when: 当你说出“commit”、“rebase”、“squash”等关键词，或询问改动历史时触发。

say.text: 把这次改动按功能拆成几个提交
say.note: Claude 会先分析文件再分批提交

say.text: 把最近三个提交 squash 成一个
say.note: 会用自动压缩重写提交历史
会用 blame 查出提交作者

howto.what_en: For any git task, Claude inspects repo state and commit style, creates multiple atomic commits, rewrites history via rebase/squash, and uses blame/bisect/log -S to trace when/where changes appeared.
howto.when_en: Triggers on 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', and similar git or history questions.

say_en.text: Split this change into separate commits by feature
say_en.note: Analyzes files then commits in batches

say_en.text: Squash the last three commits into one

say_en.note: Uses git blame to find the author
